parameters.note: Sawmill Creek has its own dedicated NDOW fishery page (ndow.org/waters/sawmill-creek-2), which catalogs it under Carson City County / Western Region as a distinct 'Creek or Stream' — listed as a separate 'Other Body of Water' alongside, and distinguishable from, North Canyon Creek, Ash Canyon Creek, Clear Creek, Secret Harbor Creek, Baily Fishing Pond and the Carson River, all also in Carson City. It is not the same water as the unrelated Sawmill Creek/Sawmill Lake/Sawmill Pond entries found in other Nevada and Nye/Eureka/Elko counties. Carson City has no closed waters, and Sawmill Creek is not individually broken out in CR 25-16's special-water rows (only 'Lake Tahoe and tributaries' and 'Baily Fishing Pond' are), so the governing rule is the county's general 'All waters (Except as noted below)' listing — open year around.

candidates.summary: Open year-round (Nevada / Carson City general 'All waters' listing; Sawmill Creek is a distinct NDOW-cataloged Carson City stream not individually listed with special regulations).

parameters.counting_rule: Carson City general limit: Daily 5 trout, 5 mountain whitefish, and 15 warmwater game fish (of which not more than 5 may be black bass and 5 may be walleye); Possession 10 trout, 10 mountain whitefish, and 30 warmwater game fish (of which not more than 10 may be black bass and 10 may be walleye). On a small foothill trout creek the practical limit is 5 trout per day / 10 in possession.

candidates.summary: 5 trout daily / 10 in possession (plus the county's separate mountain-whitefish and warmwater allowances) under the Carson City general 'All waters' limit.

parameters.note: Under the Carson City general 'All waters' listing, fishing is permitted any hour of the day or night (the restricted 1-hour-before-sunrise-to-2-hours-after-sunset window applies only to the 'Lake Tahoe and tributaries' row, which does not cover Sawmill Creek).

candidates.summary: Fishing is allowed any hour of the day or night.

parameters.note: A Nevada fishing license is required for anglers 12 and older. Sawmill Creek is a Nevada (Carson City) inland stream, so a standard Nevada resident/nonresident license applies.

candidates.summary: A Nevada fishing license is required for anglers age 12 and older; none required under 12.
